summarization: The smartphone UI screen is from an application with a "Find a Game" feature. The main content of the screen indicates that no new games have been found, as shown by the message "No new games found" accompanied by a sad face icon. The screen suggests trying to change the filter or inviting friends to find new games. At the bottom of the screen, there is a prominent blue button labeled "Invite friends," which allows the user to invite friends to join and potentially find new games. The top of the screen includes a navigation bar with a back button, the title "Find a Game," and a menu icon.
